==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|benefite||obsolete}}
* {{alter|en|benifit||misspelling}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*dʰeh₁-}}
From Late {{inh|en|enm|benefytt}}, {{m|enm|benefett}}, alteration (due to {{cog|la|bene-}}) of {{m|enm|benfet}}, {{m|enm|bienfet}}, {{m|enm|bienfait|t=good or noble deed}}, from {{der|en|xno|benfet|t=well-done}}, {{der|en|frm|bienfait}}, from {{der|en|fro|bienfet}}, {{m|fro|bienfait|t=foredeal, favour}}, from past participle of {{m|fro|bienfaire|t=to do good, do well}}, from {{m|fro|bien|t=well}} + {{m|fro|faire|t=to do}}, modelled after {{cog|la|benefactum|t=good deed}}. More at {{l|en|benefactor}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈbɛn.ɪ.fɪt/|a=RP}}
* {{enPR|bĕn'ĭfĭt|bĕn'əfĭt|a=GA,CA}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈbɛn.ɪˌfɪt/|/ˈbɛn.əˌfɪt/}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-benefit.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈben.ə.fɪt/|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈben.ə.fət/|a=NZ}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# An [[advantage]]; [[help]] or [[aid]] from something.
#: {{usex|en|She can't read, so the voice recording was made for her '''benefit'''.}}
#: {{usex|en|Exposure to cutting-edge technologies is one of the '''benefits''' of the job.}}
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=5|passage=When this conversation was repeated in detail within the hearing of the young woman in question, and undoubtedly for his '''benefit''', Mr. Trevor threw shame to the winds and scandalized the Misses Brewster then and there by proclaiming his father to have been a country storekeeper.}}
# {{lb|en|insurance}} A [[payment]] made in [[accordance]] with an [[insurance]] [[policy]] or a [[public]] [[assistance]] [[scheme]].
# An [[event]], such as a [[theatrical]] [[performance]], given to [[raise]] [[fund]]s for some [[cause]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=8 Apr 78|journal=Gay Community News|page=13|author=Eric Rogers|title=People, Places and Flings|text=Gore Vidal {{...}} will be sharing his wit and wisdom at the Arlington Street Church on Wednesday, April 5th at 7:00. The appearance is a '''benefit''' for the Boston/Boise Committee and the tickets are priced at $5.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} [[beneficence]]; [[liberality]]
#* {{RQ:Webster Malfi|scene=v|sig=[H3]|page=65|passage=The Birds, that liue i'th field / On the vvilde '''Benefit''' of nature, liue / Happier then vve; for they may chooſe their Mates, / And carroll their ſvveet pleaſures to the Spring: {{...}}}}
# Intended audience (as ''for the benefit of'').
#: {{ux|en|The whole scene was staged for his '''benefit''', and it completely fooled him.}}
#: {{ux|en|Since my wife is Canadian, whenever we have dinner with my family, they keep bringing up anything they've heard about Canada lately for her '''benefit.'''}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb|+,++}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To be or to provide a benefit to.
#* {{RQ:KJV|Jeremiah|18|10||{{...|If it doe euill in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then}} I will repent of the good; wherewith I saide I would '''benefite''' them.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To receive a benefit (from); to be a [[beneficiary]].
#* {{RQ:Atlantic|date=2016-09-01|author=Bobby Azarian|title=Apeirophobia: The Fear of Eternity|url=https://www.theatlantic.com/science/archive/2016/09/apeirophobia-the-fear-of-eternity/498368/|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171018055138/https://www.theatlantic.com/science/archive/2016/09/apeirophobia-the-fear-of-eternity/498368/|passage=Although some apeirophobics have '''benefitted''' from treatments like medication and cognitive behavioral therapy, others have found no way to mitigate the existential terror.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2021-01-13|author=Christian Wolmar|title=Read all about London's Cathedrals of Steam|journal=RAIL, issue 922|page=63|text=Instead, the grime of the steam years which still discoloured many of the best architectural features Betjeman loved has been cleared away, and several of the stations have '''benefited''' from major refurbishments which have greatly improved them.}}

====Usage notes====
* ''Benefiting'' and ''benefited'' are more common, with ''benefitting'' and ''benefitted'' being minor variants, more common in North America than elsewhere.

* {{l|en|help}}, {{l|en|batten}}, {{l|en|behoove}}
